title: plectranthus flaccidus
intro: Plectranthus flaccidus, commonly known as Mountain balm, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the reduction of inflammation and the promotion of wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Plectranthus flaccidus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These compounds are believed to possess antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, contributing to the plant's potential therapeutic applications.
